33a13406517d.name: Vehicle Squadron
33a13406517d.plain: When this unit is first set up, every model in it must be placed within 6" of each other. After that, each model acts on its own and counts as a separate unit for all rules purposes.

743ef35db02c.name: Disembarking Officers
743ef35db02c.plain: In your Movement phase, when an OFFICER from your army disembarks from a TRANSPORT model, it can issue Orders as though it were your Command phase once its unit is set up. Orders issued this way never benefit from Regimental Tactics, even if every model in your army has the ASTRA MILITARUM keyword. An OFFICER cannot do this if the TRANSPORT it disembarked from was destroyed.

7e88594eeb43.name: Designer's Note (forgeworld)
7e88594eeb43.plain: When you add this unit to your army, pick the forgeworld it comes from. Use that name wherever the <FORGEWORLD> keyword appears on this datasheet.

909ae4284e37.name: Acts of Faith
909ae4284e37.plain:
At the start of each of your turns, roll a D6. On a 2+, one unit from your army that has this ability can perform one of these Acts of Faith:

Hand of the Emperor: the unit can move straight away as though it were the Movement phase.

Divine Guidance: the unit can shoot straight away as though it were the Shooting phase.

The Passion: if the unit is within 1" of an enemy unit, it can pile in and attack straight away as though it were the Fight phase.

Spirit of the Martyr: either one model in the unit regains up to D3 lost wounds, or you can add back one slain model to the unit with 1 wound left.

c5ffcdb881b9.name: Shield of Faith
c5ffcdb881b9.plain: Models in this unit have a 6+ invulnerable save. Also, in each enemy Psychic phase, this unit can try to deny one psychic power in the same way a PSYKER would. When it does, roll just one D6 instead of 2D6: the power is resisted if your roll beats the result of the Psychic test used to manifest it. To make the attempt, first pick a model in the unit, and measure range, visibility and so on from that model.

f57261f2b770.name: Avalanche of Muscle
f57261f2b770.plain: In the Fight phase of any turn in which this model made a successful charge, you can add 1 to its Attacks characteristic. This only applies the first time this model fights in that turn.
